hypothesis: M184 is a low-drift guarded actor update that preserves behavior, protected key, and M183 replay surfaces. A tiny PPO smoke from M184 may retain those gains without washing out the proof surface.
success_criteria: initialize from M184 only after its guards pass
run a tiny PPO smoke, not long PPO
preserve M184/M168 behavior success on seeds 9503 and 9504
preserve M168 and M170 M183 boundary replay success-drop counts
do not promote if fixed objective improves but replay or behavior regresses
failure_criteria: run long PPO before smoke gates pass
drop any protected boundary replay success-drop row
regress behavior below M168/M184 on the checked seeds

commands.name: m185_tiny_ppo_smoke
commands.command: Run a very small PPO continuation from runs/m184_m168_actor_coupling_anchor100_s20_seed9840/optimized_checkpoint.pt with behavior and boundary retention guards.

commands.name: m185_post_update_gates
commands.command: Repeat M184 behavior, protected-key, and M183 boundary replay gates on the PPO candidate.

decision_rule: Admit a PPO continuation only if all M184 guards are retained after the tiny PPO smoke.
